title: INDEC Reports First Quarterly GDP Contraction Since 2024, Clouding Milei's Recovery Story
detail: INDEC reported that Argentina's GDP contracted 0.6% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026 (April–June), the first quarterly contraction since 2024, driven by a 2.4% drop in private consumption, a 2.3% fall in public consumption, and a 0.8% decline in investment. Annual growth still stood at 2%, but the government cut its full-year 2026 GDP forecast to 3% from an earlier 5% projection, while private economists surveyed by the Central Bank expect growth closer to 2%. The data renewed concerns about the durability of Milei's economic recovery a year out from his 2027 reelection bid.

media.caption: Argentina's economy posts first quarterly contraction since 2024

title: Tierra del Fuego Judge Orders Suspension of Falklands' Sea Lion Oil Project
detail: Judge Mariel Borruto of a Tierra del Fuego provincial court issued an interim injunction ordering the suspension of Rockhopper Exploration (UK) and Navitas Petroleum's (Israel) Sea Lion oil project in the North Falkland Basin, barring drilling, offshore installations, and port construction pending an Argentine environmental review. The ruling followed a lawsuit filed earlier in the month by 1982 Malvinas War veterans and environmental lawyers. Legal analysts described the order as largely symbolic and unlikely to halt progress on the project in practice, since it falls outside Argentina's enforcement reach in the British-administered islands.

media.caption: Argentinian judge orders suspension of Falklands oil project

title: Milei Submits 'National Sovereignty Defense Law' Bill to Congress Over Falklands
detail: President Milei's government submitted the 'National Sovereignty Defense Law' bill to Congress, toughening penalties — including 5-to-20-year disqualifications — on companies, shareholders, and suppliers involved in unauthorized natural resource activity in the Falklands and on Argentina's continental shelf. The bill amends Law 26,659 and follows Argentina's opening of sanctions proceedings against roughly 60 companies and individuals linked to offshore oil exploration around the islands. Milei called the bill 'a milestone in the process of recovering' the Malvinas.

media.caption: Milei submits bill to strengthen sanctions against Falklands activities
